pages.title: In the Blizzard’s Eye
pages.text: A larger reserve of lighting and marine food helps establish a foothold after actually reaching the new region.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Installed text describes distilling the Tear and a Blizzard. Follow that procedure after acquiring the Tear, without a free tear reward. An intentionally disabled world route must be marked unavailable and never gate other paths.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Distill Niveis Tear and stand in a Blizzard. Installed7.1.13 native tooltip/advancement explicitly describe being taken to Maelstrom; this is documented content, while actual dimension accessibility and JEM overrides need runtime confirmation.
